chapter: Piano influences: Teddy Wilson, Tatum and Bud Powell
title: Part 2 opening, 6 May 1983: a digression on piano influences
summary: The interviewer restarts at the Eckstine telegram; Malachi says he first wants to go back to other topics.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: It's now the sixth of May. I think we left off with that telegram asking you to join the Eckstine band.

Yeah. Which started out to be actually what I always think of as the most important era of my particular musical career. Nevertheless, before I get into that, I would like to go back and talk about some other things. Because when you are talking about your career or your life or something like that, it's impossible, I think, to just go in a straight chronological line and bring out everything that happened. Because while one thing is happening, something else is happening at the same time. So right now, I'd like to make a little digression and talk about some of the piano influences that I probably didn't mention.
